package byteschema_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	service "example.com/byteschema/gen/byteschema"
	server "example.com/byteschema/gen/http/byteschema/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
	loom "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/pkg"
)

type observation struct {
	Method string `json:"method"`
	Text string `json:"text"`
	Accepted bool `json:"accepted"`
	Decoded []byte `json:"decoded"`
	Status int `json:"status"`
	Code string `json:"code"`
	Detail string `json:"detail"`
}

func TestGeneratedBytesSchemaRequests(t *testing.T) {
	var called int
	var decoded []byte
	var endpoint loom.Endpoint = func(_ context.Context, payload any) (any, error) {
		called++
		field := reflect.ValueOf(payload).Elem().FieldByName("Data")
		if field.Kind() == reflect.Map {
			field = field.MapIndex(reflect.ValueOf("key"))
		} else if field.Kind() == reflect.Slice && field.Type().Elem().Kind() == reflect.Slice {
			field = field.Index(0)
		}
		decoded = append([]byte{}, field.Bytes()...)
		return nil, nil
	}
	endpoints := &service.Endpoints{}
	fields := reflect.ValueOf(endpoints).Elem()
	for i := range fields.NumField() {
		fields.Field(i).Set(reflect.ValueOf(endpoint))
	}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	texts := []string{"", "aA==", "aGk=", "aGV5", "bG9uZw==", "bG9uZ2Vy", "aGl=", "aGm=", "aGn=", "/w==", "//==", "aGk=\n", "aGk=\r", "aGk=\r\n", "aG\nk=", "aGk=\u2028", "aGk=\u2029", "aGk= ", "aGk=\t", "aGk=\x00", "aGk", "aGk===", "a===", "====", "aGk=aGk=", "_w==", "-w=="}
	var observations []observation
	for _, method := range []string{"unbounded", "minimum", "maximum", "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "named", "chain", "array", "map"} {
		for _, text := range texts {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%q", method, text), func(t *testing.T) {
				called, decoded = 0, nil
				var value any = text
				if method == "array" {
					value = []string{text}
				} else if method == "map" {
					value = map[string]string{"key": text}
				}
				body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"data": value})
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/"+method, strings.NewReader(string(body)))
				req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
				response := httptest.NewRecorder()
				mux.ServeHTTP(response, req)
				out := observation{Method: method, Text: text, Accepted: called == 1, Decoded: decoded, Status: response.Code}
				wire, err := json.Marshal(text)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				var expected []byte
				decodeErr := json.Unmarshal(wire, &expected)
				valid := decodeErr == nil
				if valid {
					switch method {
					case "minimum":
						valid = len(expected) >= 2
					case "named", "chain", "array", "map":
						valid = len(expected) >= 2 && len(expected) <= 3
					case "maximum":
						valid = len(expected) <= 2
					case "zero", "one", "two", "three", "four":
						valid = len(expected) == map[string]int{"zero": 0, "one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3, "four": 4}[method]
					}
				}
				if valid {
					if called != 1 || response.Code != http.StatusNoContent || string(decoded) != string(expected) {
						t.Errorf("accepted request: called=%d status=%d decoded=%q want=%q", called, response.Code, decoded, expected)
					}
				} else {
					var problem struct {
						Code string `json:"code"`
						Detail string `json:"detail"`
					}
					if err := json.Unmarshal(response.Body.Bytes(), &problem); err != nil {
						t.Fatal(err)
					}
					out.Code, out.Detail = problem.Code, problem.Detail
					wantCode, wantDetail := "invalid_length", "validation error"
					if decodeErr != nil {
						wantCode, wantDetail = "decode_payload", "invalid request body"
					}
					if called != 0 || response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || problem.Code != wantCode || problem.Detail != wantDetail {
						t.Errorf("rejected request: called=%d status=%d problem=%s", called, response.Code, response.Body.String())
					}
				}
				observations = append(observations, out)
			})
		}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(observations)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("observations.json", data, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
